城墙上的弩兵与近战游魂构成交叉火力；保留攻击者与敌卡对位，触发城墙坠击。: Crossbowmen and melee Hollows create crossfire along the ramparts. Keep attackers facing enemy cards so Rampart Slam can trigger.
教区士兵与巴勒德尔骑士先占对位，双翼焚风把地面攻击者转成火翼突袭；铁匠补充手牌。: Parish soldiers and Balder Knights occupy opposing lanes. Twin-Wing Firestorm turns ground attackers into fiery aerial raiders, while the blacksmith replenishes the hand.
骷髅车轮、暗影与刺客占据危险对位；深渊一脚打乱玩家站位，让低费伏兵找到空档。: Bonewheels, shadows and assassins occupy dangerous lanes. A Kick into the Abyss disrupts the player's positions so cheap ambushers can find an opening.
雷雅与太阳信徒支援坚固前排；高血守护者受伤后以赞美太阳恢复，转光属性反击暗影。: Reah and sunlight faithful support a sturdy front line. Wounded high-Health guardians recover through Praise the Sun and turn to Light to strike back at shadows.
树人和石骑士稳住森林，魔法师与铁匠补充手牌，供月光弹幕弃牌打击两翼。: Tree creatures and Stone Knights hold the forest. Sorcerers and smiths replenish the hand, supplying discards for Moonlight Barrage to strike both flanks.
病村毒物消耗敌军，火术师和商人补牌支付火种代价；火系攻击者把伤口转化成突破。: Blighttown's poisonous creatures wear down enemies. Pyromancers and merchants draw cards to pay for embers, while Fire attackers turn wounds into breakthroughs.
蛇人持盾压住通道，古城巨人和雷法师接战；钢铁震踏锁住玩家高血攻击者，给厚重前排争: Shield-bearing serpent men block the corridors while fortress giants and Lightning casters engage. Iron Stomp locks down the player's high-Health attackers, buying time for the heavy front line.
银骑士与雷属性战士组成王城前排，猎龙雷枪强化有攻击力的持盾者；斯莫作为搭档压阵。: Silver Knights and Lightning warriors form Anor Londo's front line. Dragonslayer Lightning Spear strengthens shield-bearers that can attack, with Smough anchoring the formation.
王城守军控制中央，龙狩大锤持续敲击中线；银骑士保护重型攻击者，奥恩斯坦从侧翼完成: Anor Londo's defenders control the center while the great hammer pounds the middle lanes. Silver Knights protect heavy attackers as Ornstein finishes kills from the flanks.
巨人墓地的骨潮: Bone Tide of the Tomb of the Giants
低费骷髅与亡者不断留下弃牌，骸骨复苏把一费以下遗骸转成新骷髅，巨人骷髅守住墓道。: Cheap Skeletons and Hollows keep filling the discard pile. Bones Reborn turns remains costing 1 or less into new Skeletons, while giant skeletons guard the tomb passages.
御苑守卫与乌拉席露军势坚守，让受护卫的高血骑士蓄势一轮，再以强化攻击冲破防线。: Royal Wood guardians and Oolacile forces hold firm. A protected, high-Health knight spends a round gathering strength, then breaks the defense with its enhanced attack.
御苑低费军势维持手牌与场面；灾厄独眼标记目标后，由赤飞龙与火系袭击者兑现火弱点。: Cheap Royal Wood forces maintain the hand and field. After the Calamitous Eye marks a target, red drakes and Fire raiders exploit its weakness.
人性、幽灵与乌拉席露居民形成暗属性军势；商人与暗术师续手，供深渊吞噬暂时化灰解除: Humanity, ghosts and Oolacile citizens form a Dark army. Merchants and hexers replenish the hand so Abyssal Devouring can turn blockers to Ash and clear the way.
初火炉的余烬禁卫: Ember Guard of the First Flame
黑骑士与旧王城守卫组成最后防线；火术师补充手牌，保留余灰让燃尽初火强化一名攻击者: Black Knights and the old capital's guards form the final defense. Pyromancers replenish the hand; reserve Ash so Burn the First Flame can enhance an attacker.
王国步兵铺开战线，铁龟与森林守军承担自伤；断臂横扫优先强化仍有余血的攻击者。: Royal infantry spread across the field. Ironclad soldiers and forest guards absorb self-damage, while Severed-Arm Sweep favors attackers with Health to spare.
王国剑士与海德骑士留出移动空间；如影随形使前排换线加攻，低费伏兵随后补位。: Royal swordsmen and Heide Knights leave room to move. Relentless Pursuit shifts the front line and raises Attack, then cheap ambushers fill the gaps.
狱卒与游魂守住牢笼，商人和铁匠补牌支付盾影代价；临时执行者护盾为攻击者挡住反击。: Jailers and Hollows hold the cells. Merchants and smiths draw cards to pay for shield shades, whose temporary protection keeps attackers safe from retaliation.
罪人塔的封印火: The Sealed Flame of Sinners' Rise
爆炸游魂与囚笼狱卒主动接战，罪火封印保护一名非祭品攻击者；术师与暗栖者从牢狱后排: Exploding Hollows and prison wardens engage first. Seal of Sinfire protects a non-fodder attacker as casters and dark dwellers apply pressure from the prison's rear.
狩猎森林骷髅与施术者不断循环，死亡及弃牌提供骸骨车轮燃料，镰刀守卫守住召唤空格。: Skeletons and casters cycle through the forest. Deaths and discards fuel Bonewheel Legion, while scythe guards protect open summoning lanes.
毒虫、猎犬鼠与蛇毒盟友占线，商人与术师提供弃牌；毒池修复一边给敌卡中毒，一边恢复: Poison insects, hunting rats and venomous allies occupy lanes. Merchants and casters supply discards; Poison Pool Restoration poisons enemy cards while healing the Boss.
熔铁士兵与灰烬战士接战，铁龟承担防线，熔炉附魔强化较厚实的亚伦骑士并用追加火伤换: Iron Keep soldiers and ash warriors engage while ironclad troops hold the line. Furnace Enchantment strengthens sturdy Alonne Knights, trading self-damage for additional Fire damage.
熔岩王座的火军: Fire Host of the Molten Throne
熔铁城的低费火军维持场面，铁匠持续补手；熔火吐息支付弃牌后清扫中线，重锤战士补上: Cheap Fire troops from Iron Keep maintain the field while smiths keep drawing. Molten Breath spends a discard to sweep the center, then hammer warriors add pressure.
辉石蜘蛛与寄生人组成蛛群，商人与魔术师续手供孵化弃牌；厚重盖尔姆守卫给幼蛛留下生: Brightstone spiders and parasitized villagers form a swarm. Merchants and sorcerers replenish the hand for brood-summoning discards, while sturdy Gyrm guards give spiderlings room to survive.
毒虫与弃民先交战留下遗骸，厚血守卫受伤后消耗弃牌缝合；毒性军势持续拖住对手。: Poison insects and outcasts fight first, leaving remains behind. Wounded high-Health guards consume discarded cards to mend themselves while poisonous forces keep the opponent occupied.
王城石像与王国盾兵形成防线，低费死者供镜盾投影消耗；雷属性骑士在镜影掩护下反击。: Capital statues and royal shield-bearers form a defense. Cheap fallen troops fuel Mirror Shield Projection, sheltering Lightning knights as they counterattack.
渴望王座的暗咒: Dark Curse of the Throne of Want
暗术师、骷髅和王城守军接续战线，弃牌供渴望诅咒消耗，把敌方关键阻挡者化为余灰后突: Hexers, Skeletons and royal defenders renew the front line. Discards fuel Curse of Want, turning key enemy blockers into Ash before the breakthrough.
原罪学者的变形火: Shifting Flame of the First Sin
原罪信徒与法师维持多属性场面；高血阶段护盾保人，低血阶段转换魔法追加伤害，由龙血: Disciples of the First Sin and mages maintain a varied elemental field. Shields protect allies at high Boss life; at low life, Magic adds damage while Drakeblood guards protect the casters.
灰烬与熔铁战士坚持到Boss低血阶段，煤灰王魂将幸存攻击者永久强化一次；厚盾争取: Ash and Iron Keep warriors endure until the Boss's low-life phase. Soul of Ash and Soot permanently enhances surviving attackers once each, while heavy shields buy time.
铁王旧忆的居合军: Quickdraw Host of the Old Iron King's Memory
亚伦骑士列阵，商人与铁匠续手支付居合；强化一名攻击者无视守护，并让对位敌人最后攻: Alonne Knights form ranks. Merchants and smiths draw cards to pay for Quickdraw Slash, letting an attacker bypass Guard while its opposing enemy attacks last.
洛耶斯的冰火王冠: Loyce's Crown of Ice and Fire
冰冻士兵与刺猬稳住国境，冰火守军形成双属性压力；冰封王冠暂锁敌方手牌，争取重装推: Frozen soldiers and ice hedgehogs steady the border. Ice and Fire defenders create dual pressure; Frozen Crown locks enemy hand cards long enough for heavy troops to advance.
灰烬墓地的试炼: Trial of the Cemetery of Ash
墓地游魂与结晶守卫维持前线；突刺挑击需要保留相邻空格，让厚血战士移动后击退敌人。: Graveyard Hollows and crystal guardians maintain the front. Leave an adjacent lane open for Lunging Uppercut so high-Health warriors can move and push enemies back.
冷冽谷的霜猎: Frost Hunt of the Boreal Valley
高墙猎犬与冰奴紧贴对位，冻伤追猎削减关键反击伤害；教宗骑士与玻尔多从霜线推进。: High Wall hounds and Irithyll slaves crowd opposing lanes. Frostbite Hunt weakens key counterattacks as Pontiff Knights and Vordt advance along the frozen line.
牺牲之道的结晶学派: Crystal School of the Road of Sacrifices
低费结晶生物与学徒撑起战线，奥贝克等教授续手供结晶分身弃牌；护卫争取分身输出。: Cheap crystal creatures and apprentices sustain the line. Teachers such as Orbeck draw cards for Crystal Double's discard cost, while guards buy the doubles time to attack.
幽邃教堂的集会: Congregation of the Cathedral of the Deep
执事、笼中亡者和大蛆人维持三名以上友军，触发诅咒祷告回生命；教堂骑士与巨人保护集: Deacons, cage Hollows and maggot creatures keep at least three allies on the field, enabling Cursed Prayer's healing. Cathedral Knights and giants protect the congregation.
法兰低费斥候与黑骑士保护成熟余灰；狼血誓约只献祭低价值祭品，为核心攻击者回血并加: Cheap Farron scouts and Black Knights protect mature Ash. Wolfblood Oath sacrifices only low-value fodder to heal a core attacker and raise its Attack.
卡萨斯剑士与车轮组成亡军，低费遗骸和商人维持手牌；敌方展开后以夺命黑雾磨损两翼。: Carthus swordsmen and Bonewheels form an undead army. Cheap remains and merchants maintain the hand; once the enemy spreads out, Deathly Black Mist wears down both flanks.
教宗骑士与冰奴维持压力，商人与法师续手支付残影；火焰魔女从盾兵后排打击。: Pontiff Knights and Irithyll slaves maintain pressure. Merchants and mages draw cards for afterimages, while Fire Witches attack from behind shield-bearing troops.
罪之都的薪王守军: Lord's Guard of the Profaned Capital
婴儿脸爬行者与低费亡者铺线，狱卒和石像鬼承担攻击；巨人怒斩强化有余血的攻击者并打: Baby-faced crawlers and cheap Hollows spread across the lanes while jailers and gargoyles attack. Giant's Furious Cleave enhances an attacker with Health to spare and strikes the enemy's healthiest card.
高墙舞步与双刃火: High Wall Dance of Twin Flames
游魂、猎犬和冰奴给舞步留出空格，双刃回旋移动攻击者后追加火伤；王城骑士承接反击。: Hollows, hounds and Irithyll slaves leave lanes open for footwork. Whirling Twin Blades moves an attacker and adds Fire damage, while capital knights receive the counterattack.
洛斯里克持盾骑士压线，铁匠和商人续牌供飞龙斧枪；一名攻击者获护盾与追加雷伤推进城: Shield-bearing Lothric Knights press the line. Smiths and merchants draw cards for Dragonslayer Greataxe; a shielded attacker advances on the gate with additional Lightning damage.
双王的重生誓约: The Twin Princes' Oath of Rebirth
王城低费守军和骑士留下可回收弃牌，双王复苏让两费以下士兵重回手牌；洛里安协同守护: Cheap capital defenders and knights leave recoverable cards in the discard pile. Twin Princes Reborn returns troops costing 2 or less to hand, while Lorian helps guard the throne.
蛇人和岩蜥守住古龙顶，把原本无法飞行的攻击者交给雷云翻涌；飞行与雷属性绕过地面封: Serpent men and rock lizards hold Archdragon Peak. Surging Thunderclouds grants grounded attackers Flying and Lightning to bypass ground defenses.
防火女和祭祀场同伴维持资源，多种武器的骑士适应剑枪曲剑法杖姿态，保留移动空间与弃: The Fire Keeper and Firelink companions maintain resources. Knights wielding varied weapons adapt to sword, spear, curved-sword and staff stances, preserving room to move and cards to discard.
绘画世界的三度黑焰: Threefold Blackflame of the Painted World
狼群与树女守住雪原，鸦人和米尔伍德骑士承伤；三度黑焰依次压攻、追加火伤，再复活两: Wolves and tree women hold the snowfields while corvians and Millwood Knights take damage. Threefold Blackflame cycles through Attack reduction, extra Fire damage and revival of discarded cards costing 2 or less.
环印城的吞光龙焰: Light-Devouring Dragonfire of the Ringed City
墓碑亡者与蝗虫封住遗城，环印骑士掩护重击；商人和暗术师续手，供吞光吐息清扫中央三: Grave Hollows and locusts seal the ruined city while Ringed Knights cover heavy strikes. Merchants and hexers replenish the hand so the dragon's breath can sweep the center three lanes.
绘画少女与荒原旅人维系最后的军势，抽牌同伴供披风弃牌；存活的环印城战士逐次永久加: The Painter and wasteland wanderers sustain the last army. Card-drawing allies feed the cloak's discard cost, and surviving Ringed City warriors gain permanent Attack over successive uses.
兽化病患与巨人承伤后由断肢狂怒反扑，吉尔伯特帮助伤者续战。: Beast patients and giants absorb damage, then strike back through Severed-Limb Fury. Gilbert helps the wounded keep fighting.
亨利克和持枪市民形成猎人阵线，家人的疗愈缓冲兽性失控的自伤。: Henryk and gun-bearing townsfolk form a hunters' line. Healing from family softens the self-damage of Beast Unleashed.
旧亚楠野兽与毒刃乞丐维持血毒压力，弃牌后强化受伤的吸血攻击者。: Old Yharnam beasts and poisonous beggars maintain Blood and Poison pressure. Discards enhance wounded, lifestealing attackers.
教会守卫阻挡伤害，教会居民与修女的治疗配合金色祷告延长战线。: Church guards block damage. Church residents and nuns combine healing with Golden Prayer to prolong the line.
村民和墓穴蜘蛛争夺格位，死亡留下的弃牌供女巫唤出守护伏影。: Villagers and tomb spiders contest the lanes. Deaths leave discards for the witch to summon protective graveyard shades.
禁忌森林蛇影: Serpent Shades of the Forbidden Woods
蛇群先行施毒，猎人与林地居民为弃牌召蛇保留手牌资源。: Serpents poison the enemy first, while hunters and forest dwellers preserve hand resources for discard-powered serpent summons.
静湖蛛巢: Spider Nest of the Still Lake
墓穴蜘蛛和天界幼体铺场，屏障保护低攻击辅助，教会巨人与脑组织守住湖面。: Tomb spiders and celestial larvae fill the field. The barrier protects low-Attack support cards while church giants and brain creatures hold the lake.
摇铃女与尸骸前锋维持不断补场，己方单位死亡后触发尸骸雨收割残血。: Bell-ringing women and corpse vanguards keep replenishing the field. Friendly deaths trigger Rain of Corpses to finish wounded enemies.
研究病患与星界幼体提供低费手牌，脑噬者和摇铃女抽牌支持星界呼唤的弃抽循环。: Research patients and celestial larvae provide cheap hand cards. Brainsuckers and bell-ringing women draw cards to support Call Beyond the Stars' discard-and-draw cycle.
噩梦杂兵积累手牌，厚实守卫配合护盾与延后敌攻保护受伤同伴。: Nightmare troops accumulate hand cards. Sturdy guards combine Shields and delayed enemy attacks to protect wounded allies.
老猎人与血鸦以换位寻找对位，猎人步伐的护盾帮助精英存活，梦境人偶为其治疗。: Old Hunters and the Bloody Crow swap positions to find favorable lanes. Hunter's Footwork shields keep elites alive, while the Doll heals them.
梦境治疗者与灵异兽群容许少量直击，血月收束随后反噬高威胁对手并修复生命。: Dream healers and spectral beasts allow a few direct hits. Blood Moon's Grasp then punishes the most threatening enemies and restores life.
猎人噩梦圣剑: Holy Blade of the Hunter's Nightmare
教会猎人与血虱承接圣剑觉醒，早期以血换攻，低生命时由魔属性护盾与医院疗愈接管。: Church hunters and Bloodlickers receive Holy Blade Awakening. Early on they trade Health for Attack; at low Boss life, Magic Shields and hospital healing take over.
研究大厅的患者与脑液辅助钟楼猎人，以吸血和治疗抵消血焰解放消耗的生命。: Research Hall patients and brain fluid support the Clocktower hunters. Lifesteal and healing offset the life spent on Bloodflame Unbound.
火把暴徒与教会守卫构成燃烧阵地，兽化前锋承受自伤，疗愈者维持第二阶段弃牌火伤。: Torch-wielding mobs and church guards form a burning position. Beast vanguards absorb self-damage, while healers support the second phase's discard-powered Fire damage.
渔村哀海: Lamenting Sea of the Fishing Hamlet
渔村鱼人和祭司轮流上阵，巨型鱼人击退强敌；直击引发孤海哀嚎反击。: Hamlet fishmen and priests take turns entering the field while giant fishmen push back strong enemies. Direct hits provoke Lament of the Lonely Sea.
足轻与盾兵撑住正对格，赤鬼的拖拽把敌卡拉入太郎兵和侍大将面前。: Ashigaru and shield-bearers hold opposing lanes. The Ogre's drag pulls enemy cards in front of Taro troops and samurai generals.
长枪兵与侍大将稳住中线，弓兵和骑将横移寻找空位，以纵马横枪击伤新对位。: Spearmen and samurai generals steady the center. Archers and mounted officers shift into empty lanes, using Mounted Spear Sweep to wound their new opposition.
火把和火炮山贼施加火压，弓兵与公鸡让开路线，厚血武者承接烈焰冲撞的自伤。: Torch and cannon bandits apply Fire pressure. Archers and roosters clear the path, while high-Health warriors absorb Blazing Charge's self-damage.
平田山贼保护能抽牌的故人，幻蝶脱身反复回收抽牌随从并留下幻影挡住对位。: Hirata bandits protect old acquaintances who draw cards. Butterfly Escape repeatedly returns card-drawing followers to hand and leaves Illusions to block their lanes.
苇名长枪与武士守住天守，雷光弓兵配合巴之雷加强对位突破，避开弹反目标。: Ashina spearmen and samurai guard the keep. Lightning archers combine with Lightning of Tomoe to break through opposing lanes while avoiding Parry targets.
仙峰见闻言隐: Senpou's Seeing, Hearing, Speaking and Hiding
猴群与寺院僧众牵制场面，抽牌的变若之子和小太郎补充手牌，封锁高费牌争取铺场回合。: Monkeys and temple monks tie down the field. The Divine Child and Kotaro draw cards, while expensive enemy hand cards are locked down to buy deployment time.
猴群和山谷毒物消耗对手，断首再起回收低费同伴，以一血重返战场继续牵制。: Monkeys and valley poison creatures wear down the opponent. Headless Return recovers cheap companions at 1 Health so they can rejoin the battle and keep the enemy occupied.
猿群与地底亡者不断交换，弃牌供双猿哀嚎召唤残影，击退卡维持攻击通路。: Apes and underground dead trade constantly. Discards fuel Twin-Ape Lament's afterimages, while Push cards keep attack routes open.
水生村民和附虫者牵住对位，幻影武者获得魔属性护盾，在鬼魂阵线中稳步推进。: Mibu villagers and the infested hold opposing lanes. Phantom warriors gain Magic Shields and steadily advance through a ghostly front line.
孤影毒烟: Poison Smoke of the Lone Shadows
孤影众与毒刃山贼锁住走位，抽牌商贩提供毒烟封路的弃牌燃料。: Lone Shadows and poisonous bandits lock down movement. Card-drawing merchants supply discards for Poison-Smoke Blockade.
宫中贵人与淤加美一族消耗场面，附虫者延续弃牌资源，虫体再生让守关武者反复复原。: Palace Nobles and the Okami clan trade across the field. The infested sustain discard resources, and Infested Regeneration repeatedly restores the guardian warriors.
淤加美弓手与樱宫信徒形成雷阵，贵人抽牌供樱龙雷返弃用，神龙护盾维持正面阵线。: Okami archers and Sakura worshippers form a Lightning line. Nobles draw cards for Sakura Dragon Reversal, whose Shield helps hold the front.
道玄与雕刻师疗愈伤者，苇名守卫承伤；危急时柔剑医手配合护盾稳住残局。: Dogen and the Sculptor heal the wounded while Ashina guards absorb damage. In a crisis, Gentle Blade, Healing Hand and Shields stabilize the remaining field.
平田火兵与孤影忍者让敌卡暴露，抽牌故人提供识破落斩的代价，再由快攻武者收尾。: Hirata fire troops and Lone Shadow ninjas expose enemy cards. Card-drawing old friends pay for Read and Plunge, then swift warriors finish the battle.

船票没带，就拿你这手烂牌来抵？: No ticket for the ship? You mean to pay with that dreadful hand?
灯灭了，你连自己的祭品都认不清，还想认出我的刀？: The lights went out. You cannot recognize your own sacrifices, yet hope to recognize my blade?

喝下这口毒再慢慢想，反正下一回合也轮不到你了。: Drink this poison and think at your leisure. The next round will not be yours anyway.
地板上的洞不是给你放弃牌堆的，是给你自己留的。: That hole in the floor is not for your discard pile. It is reserved for you.
别嫌这里的味道重，很快就分不清哪块是你了。: Do not complain about the smell. Soon no one will know which piece is yours.
渴望会把人带到王座，也会把不会打牌的人带进墓里。: Want can lead one to a throne. It also leads poor card players into graves.
听不懂也无妨，反正你这次的死亡倒是相当好懂。: You need not understand. Your death this time is perfectly easy to comprehend.
你在等我收刀，我在等你把最后一点命交出来。: You were waiting for me to sheathe my blade. I was waiting for your last breath.
别急着离开审判场，你连入门的那手牌都还没过关。: Do not leave the arena yet. Your opening hand has not even passed the entrance trial.
追着假身跑了半天，倒把真的命也一起跑没了。: You chased false bodies so long that your real life ran out along with them.

黑雾已经到了脚边，你还舍不得献掉那张没用的牌？: The black mist is at your feet, and still you will not sacrifice that useless card?
带没带风暴的答案？没有的话，就把问题留在地上。: Did you bring the storm's answer? No? Then leave your question on the floor.
跟不上节拍就别跟着转，倒下的样子可不算舞步。: If you cannot follow the beat, stop turning with me. Falling down is not a dance step.
盾挡住你第一张牌时，你就该知道第二张也没什么用。: When the shield stopped your first card, you should have known the second would fare no better.
不想传火又怎样？你倒是连自己的那点火都护不住。: What if I refuse to link the fire? You cannot even protect your own tiny flame.
你连云下的路都走不稳，就惦记着坐上王者的位置？: You cannot walk steadily beneath the clouds, yet dream of taking a king's seat?

你这点血真不经喝，难怪牌也打得这么着急。: Your blood runs out so quickly. No wonder you play your cards in such a hurry.
握紧护符没什么用，你握牌的手倒是先松了。: Clutching a talisman is no use. Your grip on your cards gave way first.
你找了一整局的真身，怎么先找到自己的墓碑了？: You spent a whole game searching for the real body. How did you find your own gravestone first?
你只算了一把刀，另外两位可没答应陪你等。: You counted one blade. The other two never agreed to wait for you.
看星星之前，先把脚边那些小东西数清楚吧。: Before gazing at the stars, count the little things gathering at your feet.
你不是来见证重生的，你是来添一块合适的材料。: You did not come to witness rebirth. You came to supply a suitable piece of material.
追到这里还没看出来？梦里的出口从来不归你挑。: You chased me this far and still do not see? The dream's exit was never yours to choose.
别急着数我的刀，你剩下的命可比它们少多了。: Do not count my blades yet. You have far fewer points of life remaining.
抬头看了那么久，怎么就没看见自己的血在往下掉？: You stared upward so long. How did you miss your blood falling away below?
别靠近取暖，这点火气只够替你烧一副新的棺材。: Do not come closer for warmth. This flame is just enough to burn you a new coffin.
别躲着了，我只是想看看你摔下去能翻几张牌。: Stop hiding. I only want to see how many cards you turn over on the way down.

你追的是哪只猴子？怎么自己的命倒先跑丢了？: Which monkey are you chasing? Your own life seems to have run away first.

你斩得动影子，倒怎么也斩不断自己送死的念头。: You can cut through a phantom, yet cannot sever your own determination to die.
手段脏不脏不重要，躺在地上的人可没法挑规矩。: Dirty methods do not matter. Those lying on the ground cannot choose the rules.
刚砍完一轮就笑，看来你比虫子还不懂得长记性。: Smiling after one round? You remember your lessons even less than the centipede.
借来的雷都没接稳，就想替这场春梦写个结尾？: You cannot even catch borrowed lightning, yet hope to write the ending of this spring dream?
刀收得这么早，原来是连下一轮都没打算活到。: You sheathed your blade so early. You never planned to survive another round, did you?
你想得比刀慢，就别怪我先替你把答案写在伤口上。: If your thoughts move slower than your blade, do not blame me for writing the answer in your wounds.

你刚把目光挪到剑上，牙齿已经替它找好落点了。: The moment your eyes turned to the sword, my teeth had already chosen where to land.
我的马都还站着，你倒是先被自己的牌组压趴了。: Even my horse is still standing. Your own deck crushed you first.
王城的门离你不远，可惜你这点命只够走到马蹄底下。: The capital gate is close. Sadly, your life will carry you only as far as the hooves.

你把生命算成七点，我却只用一刀就把算法改了。: You counted life in seven points. One stroke was enough to change the arithmetic.
王冠还没碰到，你倒先把头低到了地板下面。: You had not touched the crown, yet had already bowed your head beneath the floor.
